properties.name: An agent recalls from reflow2 what it needs at the moment it needs it, without the person reminding it, and how well it recalls is measured and keeps improving
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-10-29: "I agree with 'The hard part of a two-part mind is recall: knowing what to read, and when.' This has been a struggle with reflow2 since the beginning of how to improve how agent uses reflow2 (in the beginning, it was often me, the human reminding the agent to use a reflow2 tool/skill). While this has got better, it still remains something that needs to continually improve of improving the partnership and 'recall' between reflow2 and an AI agent."
properties.statement: An agent working with reflow2 reads what it needs from the design at the moment it needs it (the skill for the step, the lesson, the rule, the earlier failed route) without the person having to remind it. How often it does so unprompted is measured, so the partnership between the agent and reflow2 can be seen to improve over time, release by release.
